title: Lemon Drop Salt Nic E-Liquid – Strawberry Kiwi 30ml
description:
Description
Delight in a vibrant and invigorating fusion of succulent strawberries, exotic kiwi, and tangy lemonade, crafting an unforgettable medley of tastes that will linger long after your last puff!
Lemon Drop Salt is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Lemon Drop Salt E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
50% VG 50% PG
